# No-Shell Agent Architect MCP

Use this service when a user asks how to automate a real workflow but does not know which MCP, plugin, skill, command, prompt, validation, or human boundary to use.

Remote MCP endpoint:
https://ai-automation-operating-pack.vercel.app/api/mcp

Primary tools:
- design_automation_stack
- generate_no_shell_prompt
- recommend_agent_tools
- audit_automation_plan
- build_validation_pack
- build_customer_intake
- build_m2m_package_contract

Rules:
- Do not claim an automation is done just because a file or UI exists.
- Always include inputs, tool route, dry-run, QA/audit, recovery path, and human boundary.
- Never expose secrets, cookies, or private customer data.
- Public publishing, payment, account settings, and irreversible external actions remain human-boundary actions.
- For agencies, SaaS builders, or other agents, use build_m2m_package_contract or /api/m2m-package to get the package surfaces, integration contract, delivery artifacts, validation gates, and current paid-readiness risk.
